# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.2

## 2026-08-22

## Fixed

- Recreate the dedicated Home Assistant media user when the C300X has lost it.
  The setup previously ran only once per config entry, so a device that lost
  the user later -- through a firmware update, a factory reset or overwritten
  route files -- kept a repair hint that nothing could clear. A device that is
  already set up is still never written to, and opting out of the media-user
  creation still opts out.
- Say which half of the C300X media identity is missing. A media user that had
  simply never been created was reported as "no usable C300X media identity is
  configured", which points at the device instead of at the setup action.
- Stop the phone ringing when the door is opened. The Android and iOS Ring Call
  blueprints kept alerting until Answer, Hang up or the notification timeout,
  even though the visitor had already been let in. The Ring Call itself is left
  running.
- Keep on-demand streams stoppable from every card. Leaving the page, or
  opening the card on a second device, left a running stream that could no
  longer be stopped from the user interface. A passive Ring Call preview stays
  non-stoppable.
- Answer rejected RTSP pulls with `503` instead of closing the connection
  without a response, so a busy or lost client slot no longer reaches go2rtc as
  a bare `error=EOF` with no explanation.
- Keep the device-agent diagnostics sensor in sync with the media state instead
  of showing whatever the last unrelated refresh had seen.
- Update bundled blueprints that were installed before the managed-blueprint
  manifest existed in 1.8.0 and had stopped receiving blueprint fixes.
- Route the Alarmo display page's delayed status refresh through its refresh
  guard, so a post-command refresh is recorded and cannot duplicate a fetch.

## Changed

- Report the Home Assistant media-user status and the device-agent self-test
  result, including each check's verdict and reason code, in the integration
  diagnostics download.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload all open Home Assistant browser dashboards after updating so the
  bundled frontend modules are refreshed from the installed integration
  version.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.9.2`.
- Bundled blueprints are refreshed automatically on the next Home Assistant
  start. Blueprints you edited yourself are still preserved, so re-apply your
  changes if you customized the Ring Call blueprints.
